title: Space-valued base change of a morphism representable by algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ be categories fibred in groupoids on $S$-schemes, with morphisms and 2-fibre products as in [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Let $f:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ be representable by algebraic spaces: for every $S$-scheme $T$ and map $h_T\to\mathcal G$, the 2-fibre product $h_T\times_{\mathcal G}\mathcal F$ is equivalent to an algebraic space [def-trf-algebraic-space], viewed as a discrete fibred groupoid. If $Z$ is any algebraic space over $S$ and $Z\to\mathcal G$ is any morphism, then $Z\times_{\mathcal G}\mathcal F$ is equivalent to an algebraic space over $S$. No atlas, smoothness, or surjectivity of $Z\to\mathcal G$ is assumed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-representable-pullback-presheaf-presentation] to the presheaf underlying Z and the given morphism g. Obtain a Type-u presheaf P, a natural transformation a:P to Z, and a based equivalence from its discrete fibred groupoid to Z times_G F, with the projection two-isomorphism.

Apply [lem-sfb-representable-pullback-presheaf-scheme-tests] to that equivalence and its projection two-isomorphism. For every scheme T and t:h_T to Z this gives an algebraic space B and an isomorphism of the presheaf pullback h_T times_Z P with B.

Apply [lem-sfb-presheaf-space-target-bootstrap] to P, Z, a and those scheme tests. It gives the fppf sheaf condition and algebraic-space property for that same P. Bundle W with underlying presheaf P. The already constructed equivalence e has exactly the required domain, since bundling adds only proofs.

The item statement is unchanged from live. The item is unsplit in live and side-live, with no parallel split and no repair note. Step 1: an automorphism (id,b) of (z,x,phi) is also an automorphism of (id_T,x,phi) in the scheme test along g(z), and that test is discrete by hypothesis, so b=id and the fibres are setoids. This was checked against the 2-fibre-product convention of def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids, where Z is discrete by def-trf-algebraic-space. Step 2: the presheaf of classes is well defined by unique cartesian factorisation. H is equivalent to S_P: full faithfulness goes via u*h_T together with step 1. a is well defined because the z-part of an isomorphism is the identity. Step 3: the natural bijection between classes of the test product along g∘t and h_T x_Z P keeps u fixed and is checked to be injective and surjective, so h_T x_Z P is isomorphic to A_t. Step 4 applies the new node with exactly the hypotheses that step 3 provides. The new node lem-sfb-presheaf-space-target-bootstrap matches 02YS hypothesis by hypothesis. It does not assume a sheaf, as in Stacks, and it is true. It was tested on P=Z, P empty and Z a scheme. It is not a restatement of the item and is not a duplicate: 04S6 fppf-space-atlas needs a sheaf and a flat lfp cover, 0BH4 needs an étale atlas, and no node cites 02YS. B1-B5 pass. Batch-5 flag: def-trf-algebraic-space is the general definition of an algebraic space, already a stmt_dep of the item on the base, and not a step of the proof of the trace formula or Poincaré duality, so it is accepted. No SGA source is used, no fixes were made and there are no tool_uses. Advisory: citations.json is named in the report but was not committed.
